title: I'll Keep an Ear Out: Teaching AudioLLMs Proactive Audio Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2609.21183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio large language models (AudioLLMs) operate reactively, responding only when queried. We introduce proactive audio assistance, where an AudioLLM monitors an audio stream and autonomously decides when to alert the user from a single natural-language intent, motivated by wearable applications for Deaf and Hard of Hearing users. We propose Interrupt and Silent Modeling (ISM), a model-agnostic paradigm that embeds proactive decisions into LLM decoding via two special tokens: \texttt{} and \texttt{}, capturing four states: onset detection, sustained-relevance triggering, irrelevance suppression, and de-duplication. Applied to Qwen2-Audio-7B, ISM achieves 99.6\% interrupt F1 and perfect de-duplication recall on ESC-50. On noisy Epic-Sounds kitchen audio, ISM achieves the highest interrupt F1 without domain-specific training, the only method maintaining strong onset detection without over-triggering or over-suppression. translated_title: 我会留心倾听：教会音频大语言模型实现主动音频辅助
translated_abstract: 音频大语言模型目前以被动方式运作，仅在被询问时才做出响应。我们提出了主动音频辅助的概念，即AudioLLM能够监测音频流，并根据单一自然语言意图自主决定何时提醒用户，这一研究的动机来自为聋人和听障用户设计的可穿戴设备应用。我们提出了中断与静默建模（ISM），这是一种模型无关的范式，通过两个特殊标记将主动决策嵌入LLM的解码过程中，捕获四种状态：起始检测、持续相关性触发、无关性抑制和去重。应用于Qwen2-Audio-7B时，ISM在ESC-50数据集上实现了99.6%的中断F1分数和完美的去重召回率。在嘈杂的Epic-Sounds厨房音频上，ISM无需领域特定训练即获得了最高的中断F1分数，是唯一一个在不发生过度触发或过度抑制的情况下保持强起始检测能力的方法。流式评估…
tldr: 提出了ISM范式，通过两个特殊标记将主动决策嵌入音频大语言模型的解码过程，使其能自主监测音频流并决定何时提醒用户，为聋人和听障用户的可穿戴设备应用提供了99.6%中断F1分数的主动音频辅助能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes ISM, a model-agnostic paradigm that embeds proactive decisions into AudioLLM decoding via two special tokens, enabling autonomous monitoring of audio streams to alert users, achieving 99.6% interrupt F1 for wearable applications serving Deaf and Hard of Hearing users.
